attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone editorial illustration for an approved CHMURNIK social pack, image only, no social slide layout. Generate a fresh individual landscape artwork, 3:2 aspect ratio, preferably 1536 x 1024 pixels.
Subject: An elegant olive mountain ridge, a long flowing cream ribbon-like lenticular cloud held visually centered immediately above its crest, and two delicate violet air-stream ribbons flowing continuously from the windward side, over and through the cloud zone, and onward into the lee. The cloud is a single flattened, layered lenticular form with gently tapering ends, not a repeated round cloud icon; moving ribbons and a stationary crest-centered cloud communicate mountain-wave flow without arrows.
Composition: Mature editorial romance, wide diagonal ridge rising across the middle of the frame, sculptural cloud slightly above the central crest. Subject and ribbon ends completely inside frame with generous breathing room. All essential focal elements within the central 75% of image width and central 75% of image height so a modest center 16:9 crop retains the complete main subject. No border, no page design.
Scene: Sage and warm ivory atmospheric studio sky, with a subtle blush glow. A refined handcrafted miniature landscape, not a factual cloud photograph.
Style and materials: Premium tactile felt, visible fine wool fibres, hand-shaped matte clay geology, realistic miniature studio photography lighting and contact shadows, delicately frayed violet fabric ribbons. Material and light inspiration from the inspected wind-v1.webp and sounding-v1.webp style references only, never repeat their compositions. Sophisticated restrained palette: muted olive #706936, warm ivory #fff7ed, violet #743cdd, blush pink #ffe2ec. Soft directional warm light, gentle depth, high craft polish, not a toy icon.
Constraints: No people, no faces, no characters, no logos, no text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no arrows, no labels, no axes, no UI, no product screenshot. No words anywhere. No contact sheet or collage. This is only the artwork that will sit above separately composed exact Polish copy.

style_reference_usage: Both inspected with view_image; used only for material and lighting inspiration. Initial fresh generation was prompted textually without an edit target.

verification.visual_inspection: Accepted. Tactile olive ridge with a centered layered ivory lenticular cloud and two flowing violet wool ribbons. Warm miniature landscape lighting; central cloud and crest fit a centered 16:9 crop. Ribbon ends remain in the original frame. No visible text, numbers, labels, arrows, people, logo or UI.
